stem: Which Venn diagram correctly describes the relationship between whole numbers and integers?

options.label: A
options.text: Whole numbers  Integers, because whole numbers and integers have no numbers in common

options.label: B
options.text: Whole numbers  Integers, because some whole numbers are not integers

options.label: C
options.text: Whole numbers  Integers, because all integers are whole numbers

options.label: D
options.text: Integers  Whole numbers, because all whole numbers are integers

visual_elements: Diagram A: Two separate circles labeled 'Whole numbers' and 'Integers'.
Diagram B: Two intersecting circles labeled 'Whole numbers' and 'Integers'.
Diagram C: One circle labeled 'Whole numbers' containing a smaller circle labeled 'Integers'.
Diagram D: One circle labeled 'Integers' containing a smaller circle labeled 'Whole numbers'.
